title: Quest Watersports at FLOATZILLA August 16
author: Quest Watersports
summary_html: Quest Watersports hosted Hobie Kayak tryout rides at FLOATZILLA on August 16, 2014 at Lake Potter in Rock Island, Illinois.
body_html:
Check out Floatzilla on Saturday, August 16, 2014 at Lake Potter in Sunset Park, Rock Island, Illinois. Bring your ride and help set a world record, promote paddling on our rivers, and enjoy the largest gathering of canoes, kayaks and paddleboards on the Upper Mississippi River. Choose from a number of different launch points and enjoy a paddle down the Mississippi, then join the fun at Lake Potter. More info at www.floatzilla.org.

Quest Watersports will be there, hosting Hobie Kayak tryout rides from the Lake Potter shore…hope to see you there!
